modules.name: HardwareEncoders

reset.name: i_rstn
reset.description: Top asynchronous assertion and synchronized release

behavior: Preserve five independent50us filters, quadrature counts and diagnostic snapshots.
Only telemetry byte transport is replaced; shared UART backpressure never blocks physical counting.
corner_cases: Reset aborts partially sent line; host parser must resynchronize.
Pending data remains stable under backpressure; physical sampling continues.
verification_cases: Wire-level ADC/UART,32-key atomic calibration,ACK retry,reactive effects and piano game integration.
Dual-pad guitar mixed with encoder and joystick frames; bounded-priority saturated arbiter.

timing_diagrams.title: Held byte transfer
timing_diagrams.description: Conceptual ready/valid sequence; not measured timing.
